document.name: Performer's Edge Dance Academy - Bronx
document.shortDescription: Performer's Edge Dance Academy publishes a full Bronx youth dance schedule in Throgs Neck, with ballet, tap, hip hop, tumbling, jazz, salsa, and contemporary classes from weekdays through Saturdays.
document.longDescription:
Performer's Edge Dance Academy's official Bronx schedule page publishes a 2025-2026 Bronx location schedule for 4037 East Tremont, Bronx, NY 10465. The schedule includes weekday after-school classes such as Monday Jazz/Tap for ages 5-7 from 3:30 PM to 4:30 PM, Tuesday Ballet/Jazz for ages 8-10 from 4:00 PM to 5:00 PM, Friday Hip Hop for ages 6-8 from 4:30 PM to 5:30 PM, and evening teen/preteen classes that run as late as 8:30 PM to 9:30 PM.

The same official Bronx schedule also supports weekend availability, with Saturday morning and afternoon classes including 10:00 AM-11:00 AM Ballet/Tap for ages 3-5, 11:00 AM-12:00 PM TumbleBugs for ages 3-5, 12:00 PM-1:00 PM Hippty Hop for ages 4-6, 1:00 PM-2:00 PM Hip Hop for ages 7-10, and 2:00 PM-3:00 PM Contemporary for ages 7-10. The published tuition chart lists $90 monthly for one class and scaled monthly tuition for more classes.

The studio's site lists Bronx phone (718) 882-2025, Bronx address 4037 E. Tremont Bronx, NY 10465, and the schedule asset itself prints email Pedaoffice03@gmail.com along with the website URL.

Sources: https://performersedgedanceacademy.com/class-schedule/ https://performersedgedanceacademy.com/ https://performersedgedanceacademy.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/bronx-fall-2025-scaled.jpg
document.announcementDescription: The official Bronx schedule shows weekday after-school dance classes plus Saturday morning and afternoon youth options.
